title: Stage 5.4 Amendment 4 TS-5 Projected-State Constrained EMA Smoke
unique_hypothesis: TS-4's non-feedback projection leaves the recursive EMA state outside the current feasible set and permits repeated projection corrections; feeding the exact TS-4 integer projection correction back into the continuous recursive state can recover the preregistered acceleration gate without changing the projection operator or spatial objective.

method.name: projected_state_constrained_ema_v1
method.exact_semantics: Compute the ordinary continuous TS-1 EMA center. Convert it with the unchanged floor/clamp placement rule, apply the exact TS-4 discrete maximum-overlap projection P_t, then add the resulting integer top-left correction vector to the continuous EMA center state. Emit the placement reconstructed from that corrected state. A zero projection correction leaves the EMA state unchanged.
method.fallback: Emit frozen TS-0 and clear state exactly as TS-4.

mechanism_checks: projected state placement is inside the exact TS-4 feasible set on every eligible frame
output placement equals projected recursive state placement on every eligible frame
maximum-overlap objective is realized on every eligible frame
the canonical TS-4 projection operator reconstructs every TS-5 projection
reset and fallback semantics equal TS-4
bbox visibility is pointwise equal to TS-4
invalid, NaN, OOB, and ratio violations are zero under the engineering validator
deterministic replay passes under the engineering validator

fields: acceleration by guard state and transitions
diagnostics.exact_geometry: Correction and state displacement use top-left L1 pixels. Feasible-boundary movement is the frame-to-frame L1 sum over safe_x_min, safe_x_max, safe_y_min, and safe_y_max. Acceleration keeps the canonical normalized crop-center definition.

promotion_rule.name: SMOKE_PASS_TO_FORMAL
after_failure: do not repair or rerun this Smoke

statistical_plan: Deterministic paired complete-set effect sizes on frozen Smoke24; exact unrounded comparisons; no p-values, tuning, optional exclusions, near-pass, or post-result threshold changes.
engineering_contract: Heldout and Official Test access zero
references: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065
